entities.name: Anastasija Kravčenoka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anastasija Samoilova is a Latvian women beach volleyball player. She represented Latvia at the 2020 Summer Olympics, where she and her partner Tīna Graudiņa achieved 4th place at the XXXII Summer Olympics in Tokyo. Kravčenoka and Graudiņa were the first Latvian women's pair to qualify for the Olympics. In 2024, she and Graudiņa secured 5th place at the XXXIII Summer Olympics in Paris.
